    • sslContext

      public NeonConfig.Builder sslContext(SSLContext ctx)
      Enables DTLS encryption. The relay must use an SSLContext initialised with a KeyManager; hosts and clients must use one initialised with a TrustManager that trusts the relay certificate. Use DtlsConfig to construct the context. Pass null to disable DTLS.
